EmailTemplate.description: Financial Aid template for Less Than Half-Time Enrollment
EmailTemplate.name: Case Management Less Than Half-Time Enrollment
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
After review of your file, we have determined you are currently enrolled less than half-time. This may prevent you from qualifying for certain types of aid including federal loans which require you to be enrolled at least half-time. Half-time enrollment status is defined as 6 credits as an undergraduate students and 5 credits as a graduate student.
We encourage you to view your Finances tab on MyASU to evaluate your expenses and expected financial aid you may be receiving. Financial Aid and Scholarship Services staff can help you understand your awards and how they may be impacted by your enrollment status. Please call us at 855-278-5080 or respond to this email.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Financial Aid and Scholarship Services Arizona State University PO Box 870412 Tempe, AZ 85287-0412 Phone: 1-844-278-6693
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
